parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: DeviceGroupIds
parameters.description: The collection of device group IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The device label name. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.
